notes: Input has no study or outcome locator; replication primary report identifies focal original hypothesis and test. OSF ahgfx is a report file, not a project node; acquired through download endpoint and verified report title/project. Original title and DOI verified against full author-hosted paper. Original analytic n left null: retained whole-study N=115 spans three arms and no target-arm n was explicitly located; no n was computed from degrees of freedom. Replication Stage 1 report calls itself Final Report and states Stage 2 was not required, so Stage 1 statistics are the reported completed replication.
